describes: Current live annotation CRUD, pending records, nested selection/text/tools, settings and projections.

cases.name: create-programmatically
cases.covers: Current complete draft creates preserve birth refs, flags and resources; engine and missing-page refusals reject.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: page 99 is not in this document

cases.name: update-and-delete-by-ref
cases.covers: Current patches preserve identity; absent/base-index refs and refused writes remain explicit, deletion is confirmed through doc.apply.

cases.name: selection-reads
cases.covers: Nested selection set/add/list and properties read complete current annotations; grouped parts select with their parent.

cases.name: restyle-writes-and-rolls-back
cases.covers: A multi-selection update is one atomic current Change; pending fields show before refusal and roll back as one.

cases.name: flags-writes
cases.covers: Flattened flags use the real selection patch, including an explicit unlock; a later refused atomic flag write rolls back both members.

cases.name: delete-and-rotate-the-selection
cases.covers: Nested quarter-turn and reset write current patches; deleteSelection is one transaction and restores its members on refusal.

cases.name: drawn-shape-commits
cases.covers: Pointer creation names the drawing at birth; confirmed creation and refused creation follow the real pending queue.

cases.name: free-text-editing
cases.covers: Typing stages current rich text in a hold; the 250ms pause and text.end send the latest contents, and current editing/text projections follow.

cases.name: text-commits-flush-when-switching-annotation
cases.covers: The current single typing hold flushes when typing switches records; each pause writes the latest words.

cases.name: live-link-targets-and-finishing-a-draft
cases.covers: A standalone link target is an actual engine field, pending retarget shows immediately; a polygon finishes through draft.finish.

cases.name: settings
cases.covers: Current tools defaults and shared settings preserve preset isolation and merge chrome/snap fields.

cases.name: render-projections
cases.covers: Current page/link projections retain attached refs and hide excluded links; creation anchor uses draft.get in page space.

cases.name: memoized-selectors-and-edges
cases.covers: Current selectors cache by actual model/view; pending creations already carry stable refs and accept a follow-up update before confirmation.
